hooks.prompt:
Task created: $ARGUMENTS

This is a reminder only — do NOT block. Remind: at most 3 tasks should be InProgress simultaneously. Always output {"decision": "allow"} with an additionalContext that reminds about this InProgress limit.

Task completed: $ARGUMENTS

This is a reminder only — do NOT block. If all plan tasks are likely done now, suggest using TaskList to verify then TaskUpdate to delete all. Always output {"decision": "allow"}.

Session stopping. $ARGUMENTS

This is a reminder only. Always output {} regardless of task state.
